sources.authority: Live base damage curves for all 59 weapons (damage.dmgs and damage.dists)
Sym developers confirmed to the site owner that bolt-action sniper rifles use a linear damage falloff while every other class steps between tiers
Superseded. Community firing-range tier measurements used before the 2026-07-25 Sym game-file refresh; retained for history only

baseDamage.curveModel: data/weapons.json dmg mirrors the Sym dists/dmgs polyline verbatim. A repeated range is an instant tier drop and the outgoing tier still applies at that range (NVO-228E reads 35.22 at 9 m and 27.48 at 10 m). Distinct ranges interpolate linearly. See damageAtRange in sim/damage.js.
baseDamage.falloffShape: Bolt-action snipers ramp linearly in and out of their sweet spot; shotguns carry a 1 m blend at each tier boundary; every other class steps instantly.
baseDamage.roundingConclusion: Superseded by the 2026-07-25 Sym refresh, which publishes game-file floats (26.05 / 20.67 / 17.13 / 35.22) in place of the previously rounded 25 / 20 / 16.7 / 33.4 tiers.
baseDamage.rangePolicy: Adopt Sym breakpoint distances verbatim (9 / 21 / 36 / 75 m for automatics) so future refreshes are a straight re-import. This replaces the earlier 9.5 / 20.5 / 35.5 m community-inferred boundaries.
baseDamage.familyApplication: Every weapon now carries its own Sym curve; no tier value is inferred from a weapon family.
baseDamage.pp19Policy: PP-19 carries its own Sym curve, which is identical to the PW5A3 model the user confirmed.
untestedGroups: exact in-game confirmation of the refreshed floats across all classes

weaponExceptions.note: The M250 has a special damage profile and does not fall off at any range. It deals its full 26.05 at every distance.
weaponExceptions.sourceCurve: The Sym snapshot stops the M250 curve at 15 m with no further breakpoints. That truncation is consistent with a flat profile rather than missing data, and clamping the last value reproduces the confirmed behaviour.
weaponExceptions.maintenance: Do not treat the short Sym curve as an import gap and do not append a falloff tier. If a future Sym refresh adds breakpoints beyond 15 m, re-confirm against the live game before applying them.

sniperSweetSpotNote: Sweet spots are not stored and not overridden. They are read off the Sym damage curve as the span holding 100 damage, so a later refresh that moves a window flows straight through. EA's 1.3.3.0 patch notes described the windows that were live at the time and the 2026-07-25 Sym refresh reproduced all four exactly; that post is history, not an authority, because EA have said sweet spots may move again. The 100-damage plateau ramps linearly in and out; the post-sweet-spot floor is 62, not the earlier 62.5. scripts/sweet-spot.mjs owns the derivation.
noGo: Do not flatten the bolt-action ramps or the shotgun 1 m tier blends into instant steps; the polyline shape is source data.
Do not reintroduce the 9.5 / 20.5 / 35.5 m community breakpoints; Sym distances are now authoritative.
Do not label the refreshed Sym floats as in-game confirmed until they are measured against the live game.
